commands: TICKET=$(sudo docker exec orbe_postgres psql -U orbe_admin -d orbesystems -t -c "SELECT id FROM public.optout_requests WHERE status='PENDING' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1;" | xargs)
curl -X POST http://localhost:80/api/optout/webhook -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"ticket_id\":\"$TICKET\", \"status\":\"RUNNING\", \"log\":\"Iniciando Robô Headless...\"}"
curl -X POST http://localhost:80/api/optout/webhook -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"ticket_id\":\"$TICKET\", \"status\":\"SUCCESS\", \"log\":\"Processo finalizado com sucesso!\"}"
